title: Kafka's Trial as a description of a spectral angelic bureaucracy

tellings.quote: I wrote an essay um interpreting Kafka's trial uh that's in my anthology lovers of Sophia

plain: The philosopher Jason Jorjani reads The Trial, a novel by the Prague writer Franz Kafka about a man caught in a court he cannot see, as a picture of a ghostly bureaucracy of angels that governs human lives. He says he set this out in an essay in his own collection Lovers of Sophia, drawing also on Kafka's private writings known as the Blue Octavo Notebooks. He offers it as his own interpretation, without citing anyone else.
